title: Episode About Udasi to the West

blocks.text: The keepers approached Guru Nanak with folded hands, begged forgiveness, and asked that the shrine doors be opened so the haj pilgrims could complete their devotion. (18–20)
At the Guru’s instruction Mardana became the instrument through which the closed doors were opened, and thus Guru Nanak fulfilled Mardana's pilgrimage to Madina as well. (21)

Afterward the western udasi pressed on through farther lands and seas, where the Guru encountered the sea-lord known among Muslims as Khwaja Khizar, while a frightened Mardana finally pleaded to be taken back toward home. (22–24)
